newsitem.title: CHILE: Chile industrial output up 1.8 pct in February.
newsitem.headline: Chile industrial output up 1.8 pct in February.

text.p: Chilean industrial production grew 1.8 percent in February compared with the same month last year, while sales increased 0.6 percent over the same period, said industrial trade group Sofofa.
The figures showed production fell last month 6.4 percent from January with sales dropping 8.1 percent.
February's data brings the increase in output in the first two months of the year to 2.1 percent from a year before with sales up 4.1 percent.

Areas with greatest growth in the January-February period included professional and scientific equipment, up 70 percent; glass, up 36 percent; and the manufacture of electrical domestic equipment, which rose 30 percent.
Declines were seen in the furniture sector, down 25 percent; footware, down 19 percent; and food production, which dropped eight percent.
